messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Tell your doctor and pharmacist if you are allergic to tirzepatide, any other medications, or any of the ingredients in tirzepatide.
There is a list of ingredients in tirzepatide, at the bottom of this page.
Tell your healthcare team if you are planning surgery or other procedure that uses anesthesia or deep sedation.
Tell your doctor if you have or have ever had kidney or pancreas disease, a history of diabetic retinopathy or any stomach problems such as difficulty digesting food.
Tell your doctor if you plan to become pregnant, are pregnant, or are breastfeeding.
If you become pregnant while taking tirzepatide, you should tell your doctor.
There is a pregnancy exposure registry for women who take Zepbound during pregnancy.
Talk to your healthcare provider about how you can take part.
Call 1-844-524-0039.
Visit https://pregnancyregistry.lilly.com/zepbound.
Triplet: ["tirzepatide", "has pregnancy exposure registry", "pregnancy exposure registry for women who take Zepbound during pregnancy"]

The relation 'has pregnancy exposure registry' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is associated with a registry that tracks exposure during pregnancy, as specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has pregnancy registry': The subject drug is associated with a registry that collects health information about pregnant individuals and their babies exposed to the drug.
B. 'has pregnancy or breastfeeding warning': The subject drug carries the warning specified by the object entity regarding use during pregnancy or while breastfeeding.
C. 'related to': The subject drug is associated with the medical condition or disease specified by the object entity.
D. 'has related treatment guide': The subject drug is associated with the medical treatment guide specified by the object entity.
E. 'has risk increase magnitude': The subject drug is associated with a specific magnitude of increased risk, as specified by the object entity.
